target_year_over_year_context.explanation:
The 2023 disclosure defines the Platform Solutions segment, comprising Consumer Platforms (credit cards, POS financing) and Transaction Banking. The 2024 disclosures D102, D103, D104, and D195 collectively cover these same components: D102 defines the segment, D103 details Consumer Platforms, D104 details Transaction Banking, and D195 discusses the narrowing focus on these specific consumer activities. They all share the specific topic of the composition and definition of the Platform Solutions business lines.

Both disclosures address deposit composition within the Consumer platforms/Funding Sources topic. gs_2023_7_D116 explicitly states 'We also accept deposits from Apple Card customers' as part of Consumer platforms. gs_2024_7_D134 details that 'Consumer deposits consist of deposits from both Marcus and Apple Card customers' and provides FDIC/non-U.S. insured totals. While D134 includes additional FDIC data, the core topic of Consumer deposit sources (Marcus/Apple) links the two within Item 7.

previous_disclosures.summary: Platform Solutions comprises consumer platforms, such as credit card and point-of-sale financing partnerships, and transaction banking services including cash management and payment solutions for corporate and institutional clients.

comparisons.peer_topic: Definition of Business Lending and Global Transaction Services
comparisons.peer_summary: Global Corporate, Global Commercial, and Business Banking segments include Business Lending (loans, leases, hedging) and Global Transaction Services (deposits, treasury management, FX).
comparisons.comparison: Both GS and BAC disclose the provision of transaction banking and Global Transaction Services (GTS) to corporate and institutional clients, which includes deposit-taking and cash/treasury management. GS explicitly defines its transaction banking revenues as including net interest income from these deposits, while BAC categorizes these deposits and treasury management products as part of its Global Transaction Services within its Corporate/Commercial segments. Both firms serve similar corporate/institutional clients with these specific cash management and deposit products.

sentences.text: We provide transaction banking and other services, such as deposit-taking, payment solutions and other cash management services, for corporate and institutional clients.
Transaction banking revenues include net interest income attributed to transaction banking deposits.
Global Corporate, Global Commercial and Business Banking each include Business Lending and Global Transaction Services activities.
Global Transaction Services includes deposits, treasury management, credit card, foreign exchange and short-term investment products.
